scope: One bounded genuinely2D wet rectangular-reservoir physics-only PINN study after numerical-reference archive/replay acceptance. Not a matched superiority comparison to planar/1D, not all Phase10.
prerequisite: Root acceptance of four checked/refined reference records, frozen R6 with material mesh sensitivity, preserved executable reference archive and one extracted saved-data replay.

ownership.only_existing_edit: Named additive extension-2d-run and extension-2d-evaluate CLI registrations; preserve every older line/order/AST. No __init__ edit.
ownership.protected: 33 older nonCLI scientific modules including reference_2d; all existing accepted archives, frozen source/config/protocol/axes/results/failed attempts. Root owns coordination/global status/Git.

case.reference: Unchanged configs/extensions/case_2d.json rectangle case; numerical selected ref_rect320_c0225_v01.
case.initial: Exact rectangle h1m inside x∈[-1,1],y∈[-.5,.5],else .1m; qx=qy0. No smoothing.
case.boundary: Four reflective slip walls enforced with soft normal-discharge-only penalties; left/right qx=0, bottom/top qy=0. No depth/tangential-discharge labels.
case.physics: Flat frictionless rain-free three conserved shallow-water residuals; no artificial viscosity/Manning/neural interior solution labels/hard symmetry.

model.reuse: Existing generic PlanarPINN and physics_2d.residuals with direct Scales(H=1,L=10); no E1/1D case wrappers.
model.initialization: Common fresh seed11 model tensors frozen before pilot; fresh Adam. Full fit starts at these same initial tensors, never pilot selected/latest.
model.optimizer: Adam lr=.001, exactly10000 updates if separately released; no LBFGS/adaptation/chunking/resampling/early stop.

partitions.rng: Independent PCG64 train110201 and validation110202 streams; freeze explicit generation order. No result-driven seed changes.
partitions.PDE: Uniform physical interior x/y and 0<t<.25, no solution labels.
partitions.IC_weights: Ordinary global MSE preserves exact geometric area fractions; uniform within each stratum, fixed shuffle. Record half-open geometry and execution-dtype IC classification. Small deep-sample counts are a limitation.
partitions.membership: Save SI64/scaled64/actual SIcast32-divided model-input32 arrays; reject train-validation duplicates/intersections and training/validation intersection with union of final3x3/5x5 coordinates at each execution representation. No favorable regeneration. IC must retain rectangle classification after actual float32 transform.
partitions.overlap_qualification: 3x3 and5x5 final Gauss rules intentionally share320000 cell-centre coordinates. Imposed IC/BC and mass auxiliary probes may overlap and are diagnostics, not independent heldout labels.

objective.training: Sum MSE of three residual components +10*sum of three IC component MSEs +10*mean of four wall normal-discharge MSEs; all dimensionless. Freeze exact reductions.
objective.validation: Same component/reduction rule on separate frozen validation memberships, labels only imposedIC/BC.
objective.checkpoint: Earliest strict minimum validation objective including step0; reference errors, gradient-region errors, mass, symmetry and final-label data never select checkpoint.
objective.history: 0..10000 contiguous rows; full optimizer state; components/validation/selection/persistence at every step. Pilot exactly0..25.

evaluation.reference: Numerical 320²/.225 projected80² means at50 positive times; t0 separate. Bind actual exact archive/reference/R6/mask hashes. Numerical sensitivity disclosed, never exact truth.
evaluation.primary: Conserved NN area means via tensor-product3x3 Gauss per80²cell/time;5x5 rule separate sensitivity, compared to same conservative reference operator.
evaluation.fields: hbar,qxbar,qybar and qxbar/hbar,qybar/hbar cell-ratio velocities. No point/mean-point velocity claim.
evaluation.metrics: Area/equal-time MAE,RMSE,relativeL2 with explicit zero-reference nulls; whole/numerical-gradient-region/complement using frozen reference-only mask; preserve per-time/pooled/operator discrepancies. Compare errors alongside frozen Dspace/Dtime/Dsum indicators without confidence/accuracy bounds.
evaluation.symmetry: Report saved common-mean parity for even h, oddx/eveny qx and evenx/oddy qy; no x-y exchange expectation for rectangle.
evaluation.mass: Four outward signed q edge fluxes plus absolute normal-discharge mismatch; B=M−11.8+time-integral(outward q); raw initial bias and bias-subtracted change. No momentum budget.
evaluation.mass_time_rule: Freeze output-time node replacement and trapezoidal integration, actual distinct node schedules/hash; spatial/time changes separately, not certified bounds.
evaluation.query_storage: Freeze deterministic evaluation batch size/query generation/order before pilot. Query the identical base/temporal volume operator separately: this no-dedup plan counts all three volume passes (1,958,400 states). Save exact axes/weights and computed area/volume/boundary arrays/provenance; millions of individual Gauss point states need not persist. Do not change queried workload or reuse policy after freeze.

necessary_checks: Three residual signs and H1/L10 scaling with smooth manufactured fields; reuse prior tested helpers without broad retesting.
Exact rectangle area strata/IC classifications; four edge normal masks/signs/tangential exclusions.
Float32 actual membership disjointness/finite positive output and manufactured area Gauss mean/operator consistency; deterministic init/checkpoint/optimizer reload.

Small fixed matched-state CPU32/64 residual/objective/all-parameter-gradient discrepancy with explicit arithmetic/relative-null criteria frozen before comparison; no accuracy-based architecture/precision tuning.
